cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am writing to ask whether vT Consulting Engineers has room for a junior civil designer. Your careers page says you are always looking for people from cadets to senior level, and it lists Civil Designer among the roles in your civil team.

In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and on site there from 2019 to 2020 I reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections and quality checks.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Brisbane for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. Could we arrange a call?

Marc Masarate
